Below is a quick‑reference guide to **Canadian statutory holidays** that either *naturally* form a long weekend (holiday falls on Fridays, Saturdays or Sundays) or *can easily be turned into one* by taking an extra day off. I’ve broken them down by month, listed the exact calendar date for 2023, noted the day of week, and highlighted how they affect your weekend plans. | Month | Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Does it create a “natural” long weekend? | How you can extend it | |-------|---------|-------------|--------------|------------------------------------------|------------------------| | **January** | New Year’s Day | Sun Jan 01 | ☀️ | ❌ (only the Sunday itself) | Take Monday Jan 02 off → 4‑day stretch | | **February** | Family Day *(Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario)* | Wed Feb 20 | 🟦 | ❌ | Take Thurs Feb 21 off → 5‑day stretch | | **March / April** | Good Friday | Fri Apr 07 | ⛪ | ✅ | Already a full long weekend (Fri–Sat–Sun) | | **May** | Victoria Day | Mon May 22 | 📅 | ❌ | Take Fri May 19 off → 5‑day stretch | | **June** | None federally scheduled | — | — | — | — | | **July** | Canada Day | Sat Jul 01 | 🎉 | ✅ | Full long weekend (Sat–Sun) | | **August** | • Civic Holiday *(Atlantic Provinces)*
• B.C. Day *(British Columbia)* | Mon Aug 14
Mon Aug 07 | 📆 | ❌ | Both are Mondays—take prior Friday off for 5‑day getaway | | **September** | Labour Day | Mon Sep 04 | ⚙️ | ❌ | Same as above | | **October** | Thanksgiving | Thu Oct 09 | 🍁 | ❌ | Take Fri Oct 10 off → 4‑day stretch | | **November** | Remembrance Day | Tue Nov 11 | 🇨🇦 | ❌ | Take Mon Nov 13 off → 4‑day stretch | | **December** | Christmas | Mon Dec 25 | ✝️ | ❌ | Take Fri Dec 29 off → 5‑day stretch | | | Boxing Day | Tue Dec 26 | 💼 | ❌ | Combine with Christmas for a longer break | ### Quick Tips for Planning Your Getaway App 1. **Filter by “Natural Long Weekend”:** Use the `Day of Week` column to pull out holidays that land on Friday, Saturday, or Sunday (`✅`). These already guarantee at least 3 consecutive non-working days without needing extra time off. 2. **Add Optional Days Off:** For holidays that fall on weekdays (e.g., Good Friday, Canada Day, Thanksgiving), offer users the option to “add a day off” next to the holiday name. A simple toggle can calculate the resulting 4‑ or 5‑day window. 3. **Province‑Specific Holidays:** Include a dropdown for the user’s province/country region. Once selected, filter the holiday list to show only relevant events (e.g., Family Day appears only for AB, SK, ON). 4. **Calendar Integration:** Export the filtered list as iCal (.ics) files or push notifications reminding users about upcoming long weekends weeks ahead. --- #### Example JSON Output (for integration) ```json [ { "name": "Good Friday", "date": "2023-04-07", "weekday": "Friday", "creates_long_weekend": true, "extendable_by_day_off": false }, { "name": "Canada Day", "date": "2023-07-01", "weekday": "Saturday", "creates_long_weekend": true, "extendable_by_day_off": false } /* …other entries… */ ] ``` Feel free to let me know if you’d like more granular details (like regional holidays beyond the federal set) or help building the filtering logic!
